title: Topic 12: Places in Town & Directions - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Identify places in town, ask for and follow simple directions

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. A friend is at the station in YOUR
town. Give directions to your home (or your school).
Include:
1. A start: OK! From the station...
2. Two or more instructions: Go straight... Turn left/
right at the...
3. One place from this topic on the way (supermarket,
park, bank...)
4. The end: My house is next to / near...

Tip: Move your hand left and right while you speak -

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic12_places_directions.txt, Lesson 12.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.
